company: Varsity Brands, LLC
title: OneBeat Dance Event Technology & Production Director
location: NJ - Ocean Township
field: -
description:
[under: OUR COMMITMENT TO SAFETY] LOCATION DETAILS: Onsite Ocean Township, NJ
[under: HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT] The Director, Event Technology and Production is responsible for overseeing and maintaining all aspects of the company’s technology infrastructure, ensuring reliable operations across offices, remote employees, and live event environments.
[under: WHAT YOU WILL DO] - Build operational redundancy across systems, processes, and personnel to minimize single points of failure and ensure continuity in both office and live event environments.
[under: WHAT YOU WILL DO] - Manage maintenance of office IT infrastructure & devices: East Office, West Office, Remote Employee Access/Administration Internet, Network, Computer Workstations & Laptops for all users – 75+ Devices, IoT Devices
[under: WHAT YOU WILL DO] - Manage maintenance of office web services & integrations (email, plugins, API work, etc)
[under: WHAT YOU WILL DO] - Oversee maintenance of office vinyl printer & supplies: Troubleshoot/repair hardware & user issues
[under: WHAT YOU WILL DO] - Oversee maintenance of office copy / printer & supplies for V-180, V-280, & C9065 Xerox Multi-Function Printers: Troubleshoot/repair hardware & user issues, Point of contact for Stewart Xerox for billing, repairs
[under: KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES] - Proficient familiarity with productivity tools such as Microsoft Office Suites with fluency in Microsoft Excel.
[under: KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES] - Willingness to travel and provide on-site technical support at events as needed
[under: EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE] - Hands-on experience managing 75+ devices and complex infrastructures (offices, remote teams, event-based systems)
[under: PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS] - While not participating in an event this job operates in a professional office environment. Ability to sit or stand for long periods through meetings and while operating office equipment, PC’s, laptop, telephone will be required.
